content.label: MPD library paths
content.description: Comma-separated MPD paths to query. Use MPD-relative paths, not Linux /mnt paths. For your current setup: NAS/NAS/Flac,NAS/NAS/Vinyl

content.label: Maximum random tracks
content.description: Maximum number of shuffled tracks to queue when using Play Random Tracks.

content.label: Random albums count
content.description: Number of complete albums to queue when using Play Random Albums.

content.label: Include missing year in random playback
content.description: Use true or false. When true, random playback can include tracks where MPD has no usable Date field.
